'''Fozbeer''' was a type of [[beer]].<ref name="GG9" /> It could be home-brewed. [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rars Lefken]] was fond of fozbeer, and five mugs of the brew had little effect on him.<ref name="Stock">{{WEGCite|story=There's No Such T'ing as a 'Stock' Light Freighter, Boy!|book=The Star Wars Sourcebook|reprint=1}}</ref>
